about: The grating lies unseen under the leaves until they are swept aside, when it shows itself, by writing its own `:unseen`. The coin in the unseen niche cannot be named, though the niche is open.

expect.words: You see nothing like that here.
You see nothing like that here.
A bare hall. You see a bell. You see a heap of leaves. You see a grating.
There is nothing special about a grating.
